caseNameFull: Gaines et ux. v. Helvering, Commissioner of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. Frank E. Karélsen, Jr. and Frederick Baum for petitioners. Attorney General Jackson for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit granted.

Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
